content.text: Before we begin, ensure you have the following items ready:

items:
**A Computer:**
~•~ A desktop or laptop computer (running Windows, macOS, or ChromeOS).
**Note:** While you can view finished websites on a smartphone, building a website requires a physical computer with a keyboard and mouse.

**An Internet Connection:**
~•~ Your computer must be actively connected to Wi-Fi or a network cable to save your work online.

**An Email Address:**
~•~ A working email address (such as Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, or iCloud) that you can access right now. You will need this to verify your new accounts.

**A Second Screen (Optional):**
~ • ~If you have a smartphone, a tablet, or a second monitor, you can use it to display this guide. This allows you to read the steps on one screen while following the steps on your computer screen without needing to constantly switch back and forth between different windows.
